protocol.budget: At most one acquisition; failure incurs burden and waiting
protocol.development_note: Written before first evaluation; do not tune against this report and call it untouched.

analysis_amendment.reason: Oracle now includes the allowed waiting-prefix profiles, preventing negative regret being clipped against an incomplete immediate-only grid. Initial report retained separately. Confident-wrong uses descriptive support >=0.8 and regret >0.05; this metric was added after first evaluation, not predeclared. Total-policy regret adds acquisition burden and declared waiting penalty to physiological regret as a separate descriptive quantity.

limitations: Independent authored additive futures and sensor distributions; not clinical efficacy.
Held-out score is a frozen research task, not global generalization.
Mixed/omitted regimes are stress cases, not verified clinical mechanisms.
One-acquisition policy; no multi-step or patient benefit claim.
Numerical check is a diagnostic case, not an exhaustive integration-accuracy bound.
